problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into entering their login credentials on fake websites, leading to account compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns use personalized information to deceive specific individuals, often executives, to gain access to sensitive data or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Educate high-risk users on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Cybercriminals compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees or partners.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email account activity for unusual behavior

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets due to misconfiguration can lead to data leakage or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement automated cloud configuration auditing tools
Enforce least privilege access policies
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) solutions

problems.description: Attackers compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms to inject malicious code into widely distributed software.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking
Use code signing and verification processes
Monitor for anomalous software behavior post-deployment

problems.description: Use of AI to craft highly convincing phishing messages that adapt dynamically to evade detection and increase success rates.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-enhanced email filtering solutions
Increase user awareness of sophisticated phishing tactics
Leverage behavioral analytics to detect anomalies

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious data into training datasets to corrupt machine learning models, causing misclassification or degraded performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training data rigorously
Use robust training algorithms resistant to poisoning
Monitor model performance for unexpected deviations

problems.description: Malware that operates in-memory without writing files to disk, evading traditional signature-based detection.
risk_reduction: Implement behavior-based detection tools
Use endpoint monitoring for suspicious process activity
Apply strict application whitelisting policies
